blocks.text: The Miss Universe pageant has finally crowned a married woman and mother, as Jennifer Barreto posted a hometown victory in Puerto Rico on Nov. 24 (25 in Manila). The 27-year-old psychologist and model made history when she bested 115 other aspirants at the 75th coronation show held at the Coliseo de Puerto Rico Jose Miguel Agrelot in San Juan, and inherited the title from 2025 winner Fatima Bosch. Barretto is married to Yan Carlos Barreto, a US soldier. The two were blessed with a daughter, Penelope, in 2019.
